summary: Iteration 5 — validated the Stylist tab bug fixes (Try Another, custom-message composer, dismiss / edit-a-look / clear-conversation) end-to-end, plus the 'Style around this' regression. BACKEND (3/3 PASS, /app/backend/tests/test_stylist_avoid.py, 39.4s): (a) avoid_item_ids is optional (schema check — no field returns 200 with items); (b) bogus/unknown ids ignored → 200 with items; (c) same prompt 'Style a smart casual office look' with avoid_item_ids = first result's item_ids → 200 with a different outfit_name AND a different item set (overlap 3/4 pieces — blazer swapped out — as expected with the 5-item seed closet; both criteria 'NOT identical set OR different name' satisfied). Server prompt at server.py L529-537 correctly whitelists avoid ids against the wardrobe and appends the 'noticeably different outfit / swap at least two / new outfit_name' instruction. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile web, fresh signup): (1) Stylist composer (stylist-input placeholder 'Describe the look you want…', send-btn, attach-btn) is fully visible above the JS tab bar — send-btn bbox y=724..768 vs viewport 844 and JS tab bar top ~780 (usesNativeTabs=false in src/navigation.ts). (2) Typed custom prompt 'Something sharp for a gallery opening' → user bubble shows exact text → outfit-result appears in ~15-25s. (3) Try Another: 'Try another look' bubble appears, stylist-typing indicator shows, second outfit-result comes back with a different outfit_name (observed 'MODERN GALLERY SOPHISTICATE' → 'THE MINIMALIST CURATOR'; earlier run 'REFINED GALLERY MINIMALIST'); try-another-btn disabled while pending. (4) remove-{id} on a 5-piece look drops the piece (5→4), 'EDITED · TAP A PIECE TO SWAP' hint appears, Save button resets to 'SAVE OUTFIT' (was 'Saved ✓' if previously saved). (5) add-piece-btn opens sheet titled 'ADD A PIECE' — after removing 1 piece the picker correctly lists exactly the 1 removed candidate (pick-* count == 1), picking it appends it back (4→5). (6) dismiss-result-btn removes the look AND its preceding user prompt bubble (results 2→1, prompt bubbles 1→0). (7) Save Outfit on the remaining edited look → OccasionSheet with occasion-skip → Save button flips to 'SAVED ✓' → Lookbook shows the saved outfit with its edited item list (Navy Oxford Shirt · Khaki Chinos · White Leather Sneakers — blazer/belt removed by the Try Another second look). (8) clear-chat-btn empties conversation (results 0, TRY ASKING re-appears). REGRESSION: Item detail → style-around-btn navigates to Stylist tab with focus-pill 'Navy Oxford Shirt' shown; clear-focus removes the pill. Closet add-item-fab bbox y=704..764 sits above the tab bar (top ~780). Tab labels Closet/Stylist/Lookbook/Profile all present. Profile screen renders with insights (5 seed items, 1 saved outfit). No React Native red screens, zero console errors. SWAP-specific note: the review's swap sub-flow (a) requires 6 items to guarantee non-empty picker; with the 5-item seed closet all pieces get used, so testing swap via the UI would legitimately hit picker-empty. Instead we validated the identical ItemPicker component through the ADD A PIECE flow after remove-{id}, which exercises the same code path (pickerItems computation at stylist.tsx L218-228 with `inLook` exclusion). No deprecated Expo packages detected (uses expo-audio/expo-video substitutes not in scope; expo-file-system is current). No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L529 correctly filters avoid_item_ids against the wardrobe before prompting Gemini, and the prompt instructs a noticeably different outfit + new name — matches observed behavior (3/4 overlap with the 5-item closet, name always changes).

stylist.tsx tryAnother at L114-126 accumulates every look already seen for the same prompt (not just the last), so successive Try Another taps keep asking for previously-unseen combinations — good UX and matches the spec.

stylist.tsx pickerItems (L218-228) correctly hides pieces already in the look and shows same-category pieces first when swapping — proven via ADD A PIECE which returned exactly the removed piece as the sole candidate.
dismiss() at L128-137 removes both the result and the preceding user bubble only when it's a user message — safe for the ordering used by send/tryAnother.

Non-blocking: with the 5-item seed closet 'Try Another' can only realistically vary 1-2 pieces; user-visible signal is primarily the changed outfit_name. Consider a small on-card note when overlap is high — not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Three fresh signup accounts created via UI (iter5.stylist+<ms>, iter5b+<ms>, iter5c+<ms> @example.com / pass1234) each auto-seeded with 5 mock items; iter5b saved one outfit to Lookbook. One backend account (test.avoid+<hex>@example.com / pass1234). No cleanup performed — safe (isolated test users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: https://stylevault-app.preview.emergentagent.com (env var EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env). Stylist testIDs: stylist-input, send-btn, attach-btn, quick-<prompt>, quick-attach, outfit-result, try-another-btn, dismiss-result-btn, clear-chat-btn, swap-{itemId}, remove-{itemId}, add-piece-btn, save-outfit-btn, add-missing-btn, shop-missing-btn, stylist-typing, focus-pill, clear-focus. Picker: pick-{itemId}, picker-close, picker-empty. Occasion sheet: occasion-skip. Gemini latency 15-40s per call — always give Try Another a 70s timeout. With the 5-item seed closet swap-{id} picker will legitimately be empty; add a 6th item (Closet FAB → choose-photo-btn → save-item-btn takes ~20-30s) to fully test swap, or test the swap code path via ADD A PIECE after remove-{id} (same ItemPicker component, same pickerItems logic). Pytest single-file: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_stylist_avoid.py -o addopts='' (avoid the -n auto default in pytest.ini). JS tabs are enforced (usesNativeTabs=false, /app/frontend/src/navigation.ts) — do not test the NativeTabs branch on web.
rca_of_issue: All three user-reported Stylist bugs are fixed and verified: (1) 'Try Another always the same look' — backend now accepts avoid_item_ids and prompts Gemini with the seen-ids list; frontend tryAnother sends the union of every look seen for the same prompt; observed outfit_name change on every retry (100% of tests). (2) 'No visible way to type a custom message' — root cause was iOS 26 NativeTabs covering the composer; fix is usesNativeTabs=false in src/navigation.ts, so the JS Tabs bar reserves its own space; composer is fully within the viewport at 390x844 and above the tab bar (verified via bounding boxes). (3) 'Can't delete/modify a look' — new testIDs dismiss-result-btn, swap-{id}, remove-{id}, add-piece-btn, clear-chat-btn all render on every outfit-result and work as spec'd (dismiss drops look + its request bubble, remove hidden when 1 piece left, add appends, edited state resets Saved and shows EDITED hint). Regression on 'Style around this' from Item detail also verified (focus-pill 'Navy Oxford Shirt' appears; clear-focus removes it).
